On 2024-10-04, EigenLayer disclosed that an attacker compromised an email thread related to an investor token custody transfer and redirected 1,673,645 EIGEN tokens to an attacker-controlled address. Public reporting valued the transfer at roughly $5.5 million to $5.7 million. EigenLayer stated that no protocol or token contract vulnerability was involved. The incident resulted from a compromised email communication flow tied to an investor token transfer process. Public statements describe a social engineering or impersonation attack that redirected custody transfer instructions. No smart contract vulnerability in EigenLayer's protocol or EIGEN token contracts has been publicly identified.
